## Questions as Data Queries {data-menu-title="Questions as queries"}

::: {.mini-stages}
<span class="dot s-data is-covered"></span><span class="dot s-visuals"></span><span class="dot s-inputs"></span><span class="lbl">DATA</span>
:::

::: {.qgrid}
[Question]{.qhead} [Query]{.qhead} [Answer]{.qhead}

::: {.qrow}
::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="1"}
[“what donut shop is closest to me?”]{.qq}
:::

```{=html}
<pre class="sqlblock fragment" data-fragment-index="2"><code><span class="kw">SELECT</span> <span class="sel">name</span>, <span class="sel">dist</span>(shop, me)
<span class="kw">FROM</span> shops
<span class="tx">ORDER BY</span> <span class="sel">dist</span> <span class="tx">LIMIT</span> 1</code></pre>
```

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="3"}
[Bagby Rings]{.qa} [0.35 mi]{.qau}
:::
:::

::: {.qrow}
::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="4"}
[“what’s the shop on Westheimer and Dunlavy?”]{.qq}
:::

```{=html}
<pre class="sqlblock fragment" data-fragment-index="4"><code><span class="kw">SELECT</span> <span class="sel">name</span>
<span class="kw">FROM</span> shops
<span class="tx">WHERE</span> <span class="sel">address</span> =
  'Westheimer &amp; Dunlavy'</code></pre>
```

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="4"}
[Westheimer Crullers]{.qa}
:::
:::

::: {.qrow}
::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="5"}
[“what are the average weekend waits in the Heights?”]{.qq}
:::

```{=html}
<pre class="sqlblock fragment" data-fragment-index="5"><code><span class="kw">SELECT</span> <span class="hl"><span class="tx">AVG</span></span>(<span class="sel">weekend_wait</span>)
<span class="kw">FROM</span> shops
<span class="tx">WHERE</span> neighborhood = :hood</code></pre>
```

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="5"}
[28.3 min]{.qa}
:::
:::

::: {.qrow .qrow-live}
::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="6"}
[?]{.qmark}
:::

::: {.fragment data-fragment-index="6"}
[?]{.qmark}
:::

Selection as Key

<iframe data-src="widgets/augment.html"
        title="Selection as key: click a shop to join in its reviews"></iframe>

::: {.sqlpane .fragment data-fragment-index="1"}

```{=html}
<pre class="sqlblock"><code><span class="kw">SELECT</span> <span class="sel">s.name</span>, <span class="sel">r.text</span>
<span class="kw">FROM</span> shops s
<span class="hl"><span class="tx">JOIN</span> reviews r
  <span class="tx">USING</span> (shop_id)</span>
<span class="tx">WHERE</span> s.shop_id = :shop</code></pre>
```
